generalist_body: During your training with The Mentor, no particular specialization piqued your interest. Instead, you spent more time optimising your operation, resulting in less money spent setting up the store.
generalist_gear3: Start with a stock of Household Goods and Food
water_merchant_body: During your training with The Mentor, you took a particular interest in learning about the Water trade. Clean water is a scarce resource on the station and there is money to be made by those with their hands on the tap.
junker_body: Before The Mentor found you, you were a scavenger, poor but with solid reputation. Despite your training, you never forgot your past, and have even repurposed your old equipment for your new occupation.
fence_body: During your training with The Mentor, you took a particular interest in contraband. You're an established black marketeer, and have even installed a hidden storage compartment in your store to avoid the prying of the station's security.
fence_gear2: Start with a stock of Contraband
fence_gear5: Immediate access to the Janitor Underground Exchange
moonshiner_body: During your training with The Mentor, you developed a taste for moonshine. You know how to trade, appraise and even brew your own liquor. Moonshine is popular in the Lower Levels due to its low cost, but it is also unregulated and illegal.
chemist_body: During your training with The Mentor, you acquired a nose for narcotics. You are an expert in the illegal, addictive and lucrative trade of controlled substances. You're not bad in the lab, either, should supply run low.
organ_trader_body: During your training with The Mentor, you developed a grim fascination in the trade of human organs. Certified, ethically sourced organs are legal to trade... but there is more money to be made in illicit stock harvested from living patients.
pharmacist_body: During your training with The Mentor, you took a particular interest in over-the-counter medicines. You learned about the basics of running a pharmacy, helping sick customers and synthesizing drugs.
pharmacist_gear3: Start with a stock of Medical Supplies
street_food_vendor_body: During your training with The Mentor, you developed a passion for cooking and street food. You know how to prepare quick, flavorful meals that cater to the busy residents of the lower levels. Operating a street food stall is a popular and flexible way to make a living, and with the right ingredients, you can turn a tidy profit.
street_food_vendor_gear3: Start with a stock of Ingredients
hydroponic_farmer_body: During your training with The Mentor, you refined your knowledge of hydroponic farming, an efficient way to grow crops in the limited space available on the station. With your expertise, you can help feed the lower levels while making a handy profit.
hydroponic_farmer_gear3: Start with a stock of Farming Supplies and Seeds
gunsmith_body: During your training with The Mentor, you developed an enthusiasm for firearms and munitions. You learned how to modify weapons, from handmade sidearms to powerful machine guns. With a license in hand, you now fulfill custom orders and earn a steady income arming the residents of the station.
gunsmith_gear2: Start with a stock of Firearms and Gun Mods
gunsmith_gear3: Start with a stock of Ammunition
rock_bottom_body: The Mentor didn't help you with anything aside from negotiating your lease with the Landlord. You have nothing but the Store, and a will to survive.
rancher_body: To the Mentor's annoyance, you developed a great passion for animal ranching. Rats, more specifically. You've learned the basics of raising rats for meat.
welcome_main:
You're a shopkeeper in the Lower Levels of a sprawling space station. Once a poor scavenger, you were taken in by a mysterious figure known as the Mentor, who fronted you a generous loan and taught you the basics of running a shop. His true motives remain unclear.
Now you must meet the Landlord's unrelenting demands or face eviction. Turn a profit, secure a mortgage, and buy the shop to carve out your place on the station.
 Survive at any cost. Earn your future.
aquafarmer_body: During your training with The Mentor, you learned to raise fish in tanks for meat. You start with a small recirculating system and a stock of starter fish.
aquafarmer_gear2: Start with a stock of Tilapia and Fish Food
